decisions.statement: A global name is declared in a declaration file.
A `declare global` block in a module body is refused at every path.
A declaration file is the destination rather than a second offence.
A block is refused against the line the block opens on.
A file with two blocks is refused twice.
A block inside another declaration is refused like a block at the top.
The check judges only the paths the change has.
The audit judges every module the tree holds.
A module already with a block is refused the next time that module is touched.
No module is kept as permitted.
The check reads no path beyond the ones the change carries.

definition: the check refusing a module body that declares a global
